### Your Courage Draws Unbelievers to God
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-november-6-2017.html
Passage: Daniel 6:26
Points:
- Standing up for what God expects can be difficult when surrounded by skeptics and scoffers.
- Daniel chose to pray openly to the true God despite the severe cost of being thrown into the lions' den.
- God's rescue of Daniel captured King Darius's attention and prompted him to issue an empire-wide decree honoring the living God.
- Demonstrating God-honoring courage in everyday settings can influence unbelievers and draw them to faith.
